Maya (Product): Heads-up — legal and a pilot customer pushed for the feature that surfaces raw request logs in the console. They want it in the beta next month. Can SRE confirm if we can keep current SLOs?
Jordan (SRE): quick answer: probably not without concessions. p99 token latency headroom is ~12% on peak; extra log fanout will push CPU on the inference side.
Sam (PM): Understood. We ran a RICE-ish quick score: Reach high, Impact medium, Confidence medium, Effort moderate. If we trim scope (no live tail, just archived logs) effort drops a lot.
Akiko (SRE Lead): We need launch criteria spelled out. Minimum: (1) canary w/ 5% traffic and fallback, (2) circuit breaker if log queue lags >30s, (3) documented SLO guardrails + ops runbook.
Frank (Infra Eng): Can implement a throttle on the logging side and add a batching window to reduce QPS. That buys us ~30-40% CPU delta in our test env.
Maya (Product): Good—customer likely ok with archived-only for v1 if we can promise rollout cadence. What's the rollout plan then?
Jordan (SRE): Proposal: sequence = A) archived-only feature toggle, low-cost storage, B) 5% canary for live tail with throttling, C) increase canary once telemetry shows no SLO regressions. If any step triggers SLO breach, auto rollback.
Sam (PM): Can we capture the RICE re-score per sequence step? That helps prioritize the eng work around the backlog.
Akiko (SRE Lead): Yes. I'll do a quick matrix tonight. For now rough: archived-only = low effort, low CPU impact, medium reach. live-tail w/ throttling = medium effort, medium impact. live-tail w/ full fidelity = high effort, high impact and high risk to SLOs.
Maya (Product): Also need launch checklist items: customer acceptance test, privacy sign-off, runbook + oncall contact, rollback criteria, and perf gate (no p99 increase >10%).
Frank (Infra Eng): Example perf gate we can wire into CI/CD:
```
deploy canary -> run synthetic load -> check p50/p95/p99 within thresholds -> if pass, continue to 20%
```
Jordan (SRE): Add: require synthetic KV-cache warmup step before synthetic load. Without warmup p99 is misleading.
Akiko (SRE Lead): And add toil burn-down: we need to allocate 3 days to automate the ingestion pipeline cleanup and 2 days for instrumentation. If product can't spare eng capacity, we push archived-only.
Maya (Product): OK — prioritize the archived-only path in next sprint. Sam, can you update the JIRA with the proposed sequence + RICE per step and mark "must-have launch gates" as acceptance criteria?
Sam (PM): On it. Will add RICE table + SLO-dependent blockers. I'll tag @Jordan and @Akiko for review.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started (canary-id: canary-1991234) — running smoke tests.
Jordan (SRE): Thanks — once canary finishes, we'll check metrics. If anything trending, we abort and rollback.
Maya (Product): Thanks team — good tradeoff call. Let's meet briefly tomorrow to lock dates. :thumbsup:
